title: Outcome Harvesting: course, bibliography, templates and red team protocol
description: A free library for Outcome Harvesting, an evaluation approach that starts from the changes that have happened and works back to how an intervention contributed to them. It holds an eight-lesson interactive course with reference cards and applied questions; an annotated bibliography of sources each verified at source, with BibTeX and an errata page; five templates; and a red team protocol for checking that a harvest was done properly. Every statement about what an author says carries a page number.
